integrity: Nine complete standalone files including a finite decision tree and two Python checkers; checks apply to the new finding only.
scientific_limitations: Exact VC for every ladder width; exact adaptive dimension only at width 11; for widths divisible by 11 the online dimension is bounded below, not determined. The depth-seven lower bound is established by an independently replayable finite complete binary tree certificate; independent scientific validation and exhaustive literature priority checking are not performed.
title: Exact VC dimension and linear online shattering gap for matching-covered ladders
